name: Esther Anderson
source:
Colleague/estranged mother/daughter/sister of the protagonist (depending on what cheats are or aren't used). Can also be a catgirl, cowgirl, pirate or a combination of the three depending on what cheats are activated.

[spoiler]If she is [url=https://vndb.org/c62195]Minorou[/url]'s sister, she's a virgin because she never had a boyfriend before and was too shy for having a conversation with a member of the opposite sex.[/spoiler]
